description: This file contains Redux action creators and helper functions for managing draft messages in the Mattermost web application, including fetching, updating, removing, and transforming drafts between server and local storage.

methods.name: getDrafts
methods.description: Fetches drafts from the server and reconciles them with local drafts, updating global storage with the latest drafts.

methods.name: removeDraft
methods.description: Removes a draft locally and optionally deletes it from the server if synced drafts are enabled.

methods.name: updateDraft
methods.description: Updates a draft locally and optionally saves it to the server if synced drafts are enabled.

methods.name: setGlobalDraft
methods.description: Sets a draft in global storage and marks its source as remote or local.

methods.name: setGlobalDraftSource
methods.description: Marks the source of a draft as remote or local.

methods.name: transformServerDraft
methods.description: Transforms a server draft object into a local draft format with additional metadata.
